images.alt: A beige Commodore 64 home computer in its breadbin case, photographed from the front-left
images.caption: The breadbin case integrated keyboard, processor, and power, making the 64 a complete computer under fifty inches wide.

images.alt: The back-left view of a Commodore 64 showing ports and the cartridge slot
images.caption: The cartridge expansion slot and joystick ports at the rear supported games, musical instruments, and external storage.

images.alt: The back-right side of the Commodore 64, showing power and video connectors
images.caption: Composite video and audio outputs connected directly to home television sets, bypassing the need for a separate monitor.
